proof_body:
by
  intro p P y hP hy s t
  have hg : ∀ u, HasDerivAt (fun u => y u * Real.exp (-P u)) 0 u := by
    intro u
    have h : HasDerivAt (fun u => y u * Real.exp (-P u))
        (p u * y u * Real.exp (-P u) + y u * (Real.exp (-P u) * (-(p u)))) u :=
      (hy u).mul (hP u).neg.exp
    exact h.congr_deriv (by ring)
  have hc : y t * Real.exp (-P t) = y s * Real.exp (-P s) :=
    is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun u => (hg u).differentiableAt) (fun u => (hg u).deriv) t s
  have hone : Real.exp (-P t) * Real.exp (P t) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
  have hE : Real.exp (P t - P s) = Real.exp (-P s) * Real.exp (P t) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  calc y t = y t * Real.exp (-P t) * Real.exp (P t) := by rw [mul_assoc, hone, mul_one]
    _ = y s * Real.exp (-P s) * Real.exp (P t) := by rw [hc]
    _ = y s * Real.exp (P t - P s) := by rw [hE, mul_assoc]
target_source: ∀ (p P y : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ t, HasDerivAt P (p t) t) → (∀ t, HasDerivAt y (p t * y t) t) → ∀ s t, y t = y s * Real.exp (P t - P s)
